sourceText.he: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה: וַהֲלֹא מִבְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב [וְכוּ׳].

positions.claim: the prohibition of the sciatic nerve applies to a non-kosher animal as well
positions.basis: the nerve was already forbidden in the days of the children of Jacob, when non-kosher animals were still permitted to them

positions.claim: the prohibition of the sciatic nerve does not apply to a non-kosher animal
